experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Aliquots of 20 µg of each sample were digested with trypsin (1.25 µg trypsin; 37°C, overnight)

collision_energy.evidence: ITMS2 spectra were collected with an AGC target of 10 000, max injection time of 70ms and CID collision energy of 35%.
Precursors were fragmented by high energy collision dissociation (HCD) at a normalised collision energy of 60% to ensure maximal TMT reporter ion yield.

fractionation_method.evidence: resuspended in 20 mM ammonium hydroxide, pH 10 prior to fractionation by high pH reversed-phase chromatography using an Ultimate 3000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

instrument.evidence: All spectra were acquired using an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer controlled by Xcalibur 3.0 software (Thermo Scientific) and operated in data-dependent acquisition mode using an SPS-MS3 workflow.
